summary: I tested the Sicon equipment template standardisation, the Missing Information API and grid, the AI Kit Import gaps prompt, the Admin bulk-import card, and the MOD engineer capture of missing asset details (mobile, 390px). Backend: 30 pytest cases ran and all 30 pass once the non-staff tests use manager@isodemo.com. The suggested owner@isodemo.com has is_service_desk=true, so it counts as staff and is not a valid non-staff test account. Frontend: every requested flow works end to end. One real problem was found and is not covered by those tests: a site-restricted manager can see other sites' equipment through /api/equipment-gaps.

critical.issue: Site isolation is not enforced for non-staff users. manager@isodemo.com (allowed_site_ids=[iso-demo-site-a]) gets equipment for iso-demo-site-b, qa-fire-site and site-less rows from GET /api/equipment-gaps?show=all. With X-Site-Id: iso-demo-site-b and site_id=iso-demo-site-b the call returns 200; it should return 403 site_access_denied like the rest of the app. _scope_org only checks organization_id, so PATCH and bulk can also write to other sites.

minor.issue: _require_pulse_or_master treats any user with is_service_desk=true as staff, including customer-tenant users such as owner@isodemo.com (org iso-demo-org). They get /equipment-gaps/scopes across every org and can PATCH or bulk-fill any org's equipment. This may be intended for Pulse service desk staff, but customer users with the flag get cross-tenant write access.
If the equipment has no organization_id, a staff user gets 400 'organization_id is required' instead of the edit being saved.
Placeholder values (UNKNOWN, N/A) are not treated as blank. Bulk-filling Make with 'only blank cells' skips assets whose Make is 'UNKNOWN', even though the grid shows those cells as missing.
Write-on-read: every GET runs backfill_customer_refs (update_many) for each org, and the scopes call does this for up to 300 orgs. This could get slow on a large estate.
Dates are exported as ISO yyyy-mm-dd, but the Sicon guide sheet says DD/MM/YYYY. Re-import still works because the parser accepts both.

With a Sicon-format xlsx, the AI rewrites Description (e.g. 'TEST_AIKIT Treadmill' became 'Treadmill — 95T'). Sub-location defaults to the sheet name 'SHEET1' even when Sublocation Description is blank, so every Kifaru asset now shows sub_location=SHEET1. Location and install date were kept correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: The % complete figure and the missing-field chips do not update after a cell save; they stay stale (33%) until Refresh or bulk apply (then 67%). Row status updates straight away.

The 'X of Y need info' counts never refresh after edits. If the scopes call fails, the error is swallowed and the page says 'All equipment is complete'. Picking a customer does not update ?org= in the URL.

integration_issues.flow: MOD engineer login via /MODService on the preview domain
integration_issues.issue: Not caused by this feature. On the preview host, /MODService redirects to https://modservice.pulsefitness.com, so the login goes to the production backend and returns 'Invalid credentials'. I worked around it by logging in through the preview API and setting localStorage.token. Future UI testing of /bfpo needs the same workaround.

design_issues.screen: Missing information grid / bulk bar / engineer asset form
issues: Dates use the browser's native date input (shown as mm/dd/yyyy in the test browser) instead of the shadcn calendar. UK users expect DD/MM/YYYY, which the Sicon guide also uses.
The Make cell shows the raw text 'UNKNOWN' and the engineer card subtitle reads 'UNKNOWN · Gym'. Show the placeholder as empty or as 'Needed'.
The heading 'REQUIRED CSV COLUMNS' lists all 29 Sicon columns, but only 6 are essential. Relabel it, e.g. 'Sicon template columns (essentials in red)'.

action_items: Enforce allowed_site_ids and X-Site-Id in /api/equipment-gaps (list, export, PATCH, bulk) for site-restricted users.
Decide whether customer-tenant users with is_service_desk=true should get cross-org access in equipment-gaps. If not, restrict staff to Pulse or master admin accounts.
Treat placeholder values (UNKNOWN, N/A and so on) as blank in the bulk-fill only_blank filter.
Recompute the grid summary locally (or reload it) after each cell save, and refresh the scope counts.
Use DD/MM/YYYY (shadcn date picker) for grid and engineer dates, and export DD/MM/YYYY to match the Sicon guide.
For Sicon-format files in the AI kit importer, keep Description verbatim and don't default sub_location to the sheet name.
critical_code_review_comments: equipment_gaps._scope_org ignores site-level access (allowed_site_ids), so it bypasses the multi-site isolation model.
list_gaps, export and scopes run update_many backfills on every GET (side effects on read).

with_next_service never recomputes when an imported next_service_date exists and next_service_auto is missing. That is correct for manual dates, but an old import with a stale date will not auto-update when last service changes.
The bfpo details endpoint drops empty values before validation, so an engineer cannot clear a wrong value. This is acceptable for the use case.

success_rate.backend: 100% of feature tests (30/30, with the corrected non-staff user); 1 HIGH site-isolation issue found by manual check
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows work (gaps grid, bulk, toggles, site filter, export, AI kit gaps prompt and back, bulk card xlsx, engineer mobile capture)
